comparison.objective: Insert an emergency-stop button through a keyed panel hole and thread its rear locking ring; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tab-notch alignment, through-panel insertion, bimanual front counterhold and rear-ring threading versus recessed setscrew access, collar adjustment and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Button seated and ring advanced to its specified angle/gap, then released; candidate requires two acceptable physical stops and retained setting. Candidate dynamic thresholds remain incomplete.
comparison.reason: This shares bimanual counterholding and rotary locking, but the essential tested ability is keyed component insertion and threaded panel mounting, not selecting damping from impact behavior.
